typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	FinalOutboundFileName as string (),
	FinalPRFRecordCount as string (),
	InitialOutboundFileName as string (),
	InitialPRFRecordCount as string (),
	OracleDataSource as string (),
	OraclePassword as string (),
	OracleProvider as string (),
	OracleUserID as string (),
	OutboundFilePath as string (),
	OutReportName as string (),
	OutReportPath as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEM_OVERPAYMENTS as integer,
		PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG as string,
		MEM_PENALTY as integer,
		STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT as integer,
		STATE_DISC_PERCENTAGE as integer,
		STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE as integer,
		STATE_CONTRIBUTION as integer,
		RECORD_TYPE as string,
		MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT as integer,
		MEM_DEBT as integer,
		STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT as integer,
		MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT as integer,
		TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT as integer,
		MONTHS_ARREARS as integer,
		MEM_ROLLOVER_PAY_APPLIED as integer,
		MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE as integer,
		MCE_TERM_DT as timestamp,
		STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE as integer,
		TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE as integer,
		MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED as integer,
		STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND as integer,
		MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP as integer,
		TOSE_AMOUNT as integer,
		MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND as integer,
		MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER as integer,
		STATE_PAC_FUNDED as integer,
		STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT as integer,
		MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT as integer,
		DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT as integer,
		MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED as integer,
		MEM_PAYMENTS as integer,
		TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT as integer,
		RID as string,
		MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY as integer,
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT as timestamp,
		MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE as integer,
		MCE_EFF_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_PAC_AMT as integer,
		STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE as integer,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT as timestamp,
		MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE as integer,
		MEM_REFUND_AMT as integer,
		INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT /*+parallel(4)+*/       PRFC.RECORD_TYPE,        PRFC.RID,        TRUNC (PRFC.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT) AS BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,        TRUNC (PRFC.BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT) AS BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,        TRUNC (PRFC.MCE_EFF_DT) AS MCE_EFF_DT,        TRUNC (PRFC.MCE_TERM_DT) AS MCE_TERM_DT,        PRFC.MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED,        PRFC.MONTHS_ARREARS,        PRFC.INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING,        PRFC.LAST_PAC_AMT,        PRFC.STATE_PAC_FUNDED,        PRFC.MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE,        PRFC.MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,        PRFC.STATE_DISC_PERCENTAGE,        PRFC.STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,        PRFC.TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,        PRFC.MEM_OVERPAYMENTS,        PRFC.MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY,        PRFC.STATE_CONTRIBUTION,        PRFC.MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED,        PRFC.MEM_ROLLOVER_PAY_APPLIED,        PRFC.MEM_PAYMENTS,        PRFC.STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT,        PRFC.STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE,        PRFC.MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,        PRFC.STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,        PRFC.TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,        PRFC.MEM_PENALTY,        PRFC.MEM_REFUND_AMT,        PRFC.STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT,        PRFC.TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT,        PRFC.MEM_DEBT,        PRFC.MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP,        PRFC.PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG,        PRFC.MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER,        PRFC.MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,        PRFC.STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,        PRFC.MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,        PRFC.MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT,        PRFC.DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT,        PRFC.STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,        PRFC.MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT,        PRFC.TOSE_AMOUNT   FROM AGP.PRF_CALC_OUTPUT_MAPPING PRFC WHERE NVL(ERROR_FLAG,\'Y\')<>\'E\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DSPullFinalDatafromStagingtable
DSPullFinalDatafromStagingtable sink(input(
		Member_Overpayments as string,
		Preventative_Services_Flag as string,
		Member_Penalty as string,
		State_Rollover_Amount as string,
		State_Discount_Percentage as string,
		State_Rollover_Paid_to_Prior_MCE as string,
		State_Contributions as string,
		Record_Type as string,
		Member_Rollover_Amount as string,
		Member_Debt as string,
		State_Discount_Amount as string,
		{Prior_Year_Discount_Amount-Member_Transfer_Only} as string,
		Total_Rollover_Amount as string,
		Number_of_Months_in_Arrears as string,
		{Member_Discount_Payments-Total} as string,
		Member_Rollover_Applied_as_Credit_to_Prior_MCE as string,
		MCE_Coverage_Period_End_Date as string,
		{Difference_to_be_Funded_by_820_True-up_Amount} as string,
		Total_Power_Account_Claims_Amount_paid_by_MCE as string,
		Number_of_Months_Member_Inccured as string,
		{Prior_Year_Unused_Discount_-_State} as string,
		Debt_Not_Paid_due_to_Basic_and_Plus_Caps as string,
		Tobacco_Surcharge as string,
		{Prior_Year_Unused_Rollover_dollars-Member} as string,
		{Member_-_State_recoup_due_to_Rollover} as string,
		State_Power_Account_Funded as string,
		State_Refund_Amount as string,
		Member_Overpayment_due_to_Discount as string,
		Debt_colloected_for_Prior_Debt as string,
		{Member_Required_Contributions-Total} as string,
		{Member_Payments-Total} as string,
		Total_Refunded_Amount as string,
		RID as string,
		Member_Contribution as string,
		Benefit_Period_Begin_Date as string,
		Paid_to_Other_MCE as string,
		MCE_Coverage_Period_Begin_Date as string,
		Last_PAC_amount as string,
		State_Power_Account_Claims_Paid_by_MCE as string,
		Benefit_Period_End_Date as string,
		Member_Power_Account_Claims_Paid_by_MCE as string,
		Member_Refund_Amount as string,
		Incurred_Months_Remaining as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Member_Overpayments = MEM_OVERPAYMENTS,
		Preventative_Services_Flag = PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG,
		Member_Penalty = MEM_PENALTY,
		State_Rollover_Amount = STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
		State_Discount_Percentage = STATE_DISC_PERCENTAGE,
		State_Rollover_Paid_to_Prior_MCE = STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,
		State_Contributions = STATE_CONTRIBUTION,
		Record_Type = RECORD_TYPE,
		Member_Rollover_Amount = MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
		Member_Debt = MEM_DEBT,
		State_Discount_Amount = STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT,
		{Prior_Year_Discount_Amount-Member_Transfer_Only} = MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT,
		Total_Rollover_Amount = TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
		Number_of_Months_in_Arrears = MONTHS_ARREARS,
		{Member_Discount_Payments-Total} = MEM_ROLLOVER_PAY_APPLIED,
		Member_Rollover_Applied_as_Credit_to_Prior_MCE = MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,
		MCE_Coverage_Period_End_Date = MCE_TERM_DT,
		{Difference_to_be_Funded_by_820_True-up_Amount} = STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE,
		Total_Power_Account_Claims_Amount_paid_by_MCE = TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
		Number_of_Months_Member_Inccured = MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED,
		{Prior_Year_Unused_Discount_-_State} = STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,
		Debt_Not_Paid_due_to_Basic_and_Plus_Caps = MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP,
		Tobacco_Surcharge = TOSE_AMOUNT,
		{Prior_Year_Unused_Rollover_dollars-Member} = MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,
		{Member_-_State_recoup_due_to_Rollover} = MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER,
		State_Power_Account_Funded = STATE_PAC_FUNDED,
		State_Refund_Amount = STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT,
		Member_Overpayment_due_to_Discount = MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT,
		Debt_colloected_for_Prior_Debt = DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT,
		{Member_Required_Contributions-Total} = MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED,
		{Member_Payments-Total} = MEM_PAYMENTS,
		Total_Refunded_Amount = TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT,
		RID,
		Member_Contribution = MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY,
		Benefit_Period_Begin_Date = BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,
		Paid_to_Other_MCE = MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE,
		MCE_Coverage_Period_Begin_Date = MCE_EFF_DT,
		Last_PAC_amount = LAST_PAC_AMT,
		State_Power_Account_Claims_Paid_by_MCE = STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
		Benefit_Period_End_Date = BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,
		Member_Power_Account_Claims_Paid_by_MCE = MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
		Member_Refund_Amount = MEM_REFUND_AMT,
		Incurred_Months_Remaining = INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING)) ~> FinalReportfile
